children: MediaAlpha entered into an Assignment, Assumption and Termination Agreement to purchase PLX’s interest in its Tax Receivables Agreement for $12.0 million in cash, a 47% discount to the estimated value as of June 30, 2026. The PLX-related portion of the TRA liability was $22.7 million of the total $54.7 million estimate. Following the transaction, MediaAlpha expects its remaining TRA liability to be approximately $32 million as of September 30, 2026. The deal does not trigger a change of control or early termination under the TRA, and remaining obligations to other counterparties continue.
